text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm--? Between your eyebrows, is there 
something--

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For now, tell Trainer and have a doctor 
look at it—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa!? Wouldn't you have to take off 
your mask for that?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, but the pimple hurts. Maybe I 
really should get it checked...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No! Absolutely not! I can't take this mask 
off...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah~~n!! What is El supposed to 
dooooo-ッ!!

El Condor Pasa's skin seems to be in bad 
shape...
